ice_depth.description: The calculated depth at which water ice would be sublimated at a rate of 1 kg m-2 per billion years (m). Notes: If the calculated depth at which water ice would be sublimated at a rate of 1 kg m-2 per billion years is zero, then water ice is stable to sublimation at the surface. Also, if the calculated depth at which water ice would be sublimated at a rate of 1 kg m-2 per billion years is greater than 2.8738 meters, then the exclude value of -999.0 is reported.

aoi.name: Shackleton Rim / R04 Site04 comparison window
aoi.projection_method: Each Diviner triangle centroid is converted to local east/north coordinates using a spherical azimuthal-equidistant calculation on the 1737.4 km lunar reference sphere; rows with |east| and |north| ≤ 14.8 km are selected.
aoi.geometry_note: This is an analyst-defined comparison window centered on the existing LOLA Shackleton R04 point, not a NASA-designated landing/base boundary.

source_semantics.product_context: PRP V2.0 is derived from thermal-model fits to Diviner observations from the first year of LRO mapping orbit; it is a model-based polar resource product.

temperature_average_at_2cm_K.description: The annual average temperature (K), calculated at a depth of 2 cm below the surface

temperature_average_at_2cm_C.description: Converted from the PDS temperature-average field in kelvin; not a surface temperature.

annual_maximum_surface_temperature_K.description: The annual maximum temperature (K), calculated at the surface

annual_maximum_surface_temperature_C.description: Converted from the PDS annual maximum surface temperature field in kelvin.

ice_depth_model.description: The calculated depth at which water ice would be sublimated at a rate of 1 kg m-2 per billion years (m). Notes: If the calculated depth at which water ice would be sublimated at a rate of 1 kg m-2 per billion years is zero, then water ice is stable to sublimation at the surface. Also, if the calculated depth at which water ice would be sublimated at a rate of 1 kg m-2 per billion years is greater than 2.8738 meters, then the exclude value of -999.0 is reported.
ice_depth_model.interpretation: A value of 0 means the thermal model indicates water ice would be stable against sublimation at the surface under the product's stated criterion (1 kg m-2 per billion years). It is not a direct ice detection, abundance, thickness, accessibility or resource-reserve measurement. Values reported as -999 are censored because the calculated depth exceeds 2.8738 m; other negative or above-limit values are excluded from valid-depth statistics.

limitations: These are model-derived values from the Diviner PRP V2.0 product, not in-situ ice measurements.
The product is based on first-year mapping-orbit observations and its thermal-model assumptions; it is not a live forecast.
ice_depth -999 values mean the modeled depth exceeds 2.8738 m under the product criterion; they are censored, not zero.
A surface-stable classification is not proof of exposed, accessible, concentrated or mineable ice.
The AOI is a 29.6 km square comparison window, not a surveyed landing ellipse, habitat footprint or rover traverse plan.
Illumination, long-duration power, communications, slope hazards, local geology, radiation and access are separate site-selection dimensions.
